title: BoRP: Bootstrapped Regression Probing for Scalable and Human-Aligned LLM Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the score distribution of generative LLM evaluators (e.g., Qwen3-14B) to detect clustering around median scores and the suppression of extreme judgments (referred to as the 'Alignment Tax').

Evaluating the evaluation framework's robustness on the HelpSteer2 (Verbosity) dataset to detect 'Score Inflation' or severe calibration failures where generative models systematically over-rate responses simply because they are lengthy.

Applying 'Middle-Out' context compression to long conversation histories and measuring if the LLM retains accuracy, acknowledging and testing around the model's inherent bias towards heavily weighting recent (final) tokens.
